canonical_rules: Use stock_item as the product/item master when item identity or product metadata is requested.
For product-level sales analysis, start with sales + sold_items. Use sold_items.total_price for stored line sales value unless application logic proves another definition.
For cost of sales, use sold_items.Cost_of_sale when the question asks for stored cost of sales.
For payment-method analysis, use sales_payment_methods joined to sales.
Use inventoryV2/shop_stock_v2 for V2 inventory workflows; do not silently merge them with inventory/shop_stock.
Use inventory/shop_stock when the question explicitly concerns the legacy/original inventory workflow or when application logic identifies those tables as the source.
Do not combine stock, shop_stock, shop_stock_v2 and LiveStock unless the question specifically requires reconciliation across those concepts.
Use expenses for expense transaction totals; use expenses_ledger when the question is about accounting postings/GL entries.
Use chart_of_accounts + accounting ledgers for accounting/GL questions rather than reconstructing balances from operational tables.
Use etims_sales/etims_sale_items for eTIMS-specific questions; use sales/sold_items for local operational sales unless the question explicitly asks about eTIMS.
Mabanda tables are a separate/legacy operational family. Do not mix them with the main sales/inventory tables without explicit user intent.
Never use passwords, 2FA secrets/codes, backup codes or push-subscription credentials in analytics.

stock_item.purpose: Canonical item/master-product table. Stores item identity, pricing, category, eTIMS attributes and stock-item type.
avoid_for: current shop quantity unless specifically joined to stock/shop stock

sales.purpose: Sale header/transaction record. Identifies the sale, shop, user, customer and sale status/date.

sold_items.purpose: Line items belonging to a sale.

key_fields.total_price: line total as stored by the application
key_fields.Cost_of_sale: cost of sale value as stored

sales_payment_methods.purpose: Payment records attached to sales, including method, amount, discount and payment-provider status.

inventoryV2.purpose: Newer inventory/purchase stock receipt table with quantities, costs, supplier details, batch, payment status, VAT and timestamps.
preferred_over: inventory for V2/current inventory workflows when the question concerns the newer inventory implementation

shop_stock_v2.purpose: Shop-level stock derived from V2 inventory/transfers.

avoid_for: questions explicitly referring to V2/current inventory when V2 is applicable
V2 shop-stock questions when shop_stock_v2 is applicable

stock.purpose: Shop stock snapshot/record with item, quantity, cost and selling price.
use_for: stock records where this table is the application's relevant source
stock.warning: Do not automatically combine stock with shop_stock or shop_stock_v2; these are separate storage models.

expenses.purpose: Expense transaction header with shop, category text, creditor, totals, payment status and distribution status.

chart_of_accounts.purpose: Chart of accounts/master GL account table.

bank_account.purpose: Bank account master/balance table linked to chart of accounts.

banking_transaction.purpose: Banking transaction record containing credit/debit amounts and account reference.

joins: etims_sales.local_sale_id -> sales.sales_id (application relationship; verify FK not declared)

etims_sale_items.purpose: Line items stored for eTIMS sales/invoices.

customers.purpose: Customer and loyalty summary records associated with shops/sales/users.

suppliers.purpose: Supplier master/contact/payment information and aggregate received/credit amounts.
avoid_for: supplier transaction history when supplier_history is the appropriate source

supplier_history.purpose: Supplier transaction/history records linked to supplier and inventory.

task_manager.purpose: Task management records, assignees, status, priority, recurrence and shop.
